verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API that covers workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions, with a stated OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api. It also offers an HTTP ingestion API and named, expiring user API tokens and personal API keys for headless access. The probe's 404s hit guessed spec paths, not the stated reference location, so they do not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Management API, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec confirmed at a retrievable URL.
